title.narrative: Public Service Sector Public-Private Partnership Promotion and Elderly Care Demonstration Project

description.narrative: The proposed project aims to support Xiangyang Municipality in Hubei Province of the People's Republic of China (PRC) to strengthen coordinated elderly care service provision by helping establish an elderly care system, strengthening elderly care and health care service provision, and enhancing the involvement of the private sector in elderly care.

Output: PPP subproject for elderly care service provision developed Indicator: By 2027, at least one elderly care facility for care services built and operated through a PPP model (2021 baseline: 0) Achievement: n/a Progress/Status: On track. According to the approved FSR, the Dongjin subproject will allocate 200 beds under the PBPO model. The Xiangyang PMO has also agreed to expand support for low‑income groups beyond the originally planned 200 PBPO beds. During the mission, an indicative figure of approximately 1,100 affordable beds for poor and vulnerable populations—covering both PBPO and non‑PBPO models—was discussed. The PMO will provide a detailed explanation of the affordable beds scheme, including the distinction between PBPO and non‑PBPO arrangements. The final details and confirmed number of beds will be determined following further consultation with the government, which is expected to be completed in Q1 2026 Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring reports of XPMO Baseline year: 2021 Baseline value: 0 Target year: 2027 Target value: 1 Actual value: Not applicable
